study_identification_part.si4_title: Deep Normative Tractometry for Identifying Joint White Matter Macro- and Micro-structural Abnormalities in Alzheimer's Disease

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Introduce and evaluate Deep Normative Tractometry (DNT), a variational autoencoder-based normative modeling framework that jointly models white matter tract geometry and DTI microstructure; leverage large-sample pretraining and transfer learning to an independent Indian cohort and assess detection of along-tract abnormalities in MCI and Alzheimer's disease, comparing to BUAN tractometry.

rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.answer: DWI denoising (local PCA); Gibbs ringing removal; Susceptibility, eddy-current, and bias-field correction; DTI fit (non-linear least squares) to FA and MD; RUMBA-SD for FODs; Particle filtering tractography; DIPY RecoBundles segmentation in native and MNI spaces; TractoInferno WBT via CSD + deterministic tracking
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.reason: The Methods section lists explicit preprocessing and tractography steps and tools for both NIMHANS and pretraining datasets.
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.supporting_text: Preprocessing steps for all DWI volumes included: denoising using local principal component analysis ... Gibbs ringing removal ... correction of susceptibility-induced distortion ... eddy currents ... bias field inhomogeneity ... Diffusion tensors were fitted ... to produce fractional anisotropy (FA) and medial diffusivity (MD) ... Fiber orientations were reconstructed using Robust and Unbiased Model-BAsed Spherical Deconvolution (RUMBA-SD) ... Particle filtering tracking ... generate whole-brain tractograms ...; Constrained spherical deconvolution and deterministic tracking were used to generate WBTs. DIPY's auto-calibrated RecoBundles was used to segment thirty WM bundles in the native and MNI space.
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.location: Feng2024.pdf.md: Methods / Scanner & preprocessing; Pretraining dataset description

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Linear mixed models on along-tract segments with diagnosis, age, sex as fixed effects and subject and scanner as random effects; multiple comparison correction by FDR.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: DNT detected widespread along-tract diffusivity abnormalities in MCI and AD that closely aligned with BUAN results; inclusion of tract geometry enabled separation of anisotropy from macrostructural effects.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Pretrained-and-finetuned DNT produced segment-wise maps highlighting abnormalities in MD and FA across multiple bundles; results paralleled BUAN tractometry while additionally providing 'shape' (geometry) anomaly maps, suggesting complementary sensitivity to macrostructural differences.
